users_role_organization_consistency.name: users_role_organization_consistency
users_role_organization_consistency.value:
("users"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("users"."role" <> 'super_admin' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)

commissions_basis_fields_consistency.name: commissions_basis_fields_consistency
commissions_basis_fields_consistency.value:
("commissions"."basis" = 'percentage' AND "commissions"."rate" IS NOT NULL AND "commissions"."fixed_amount" IS NULL)
        OR ("commissions"."basis" = 'fixed' AND "commissions"."fixed_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "commissions"."rate" IS NULL)

deal_events_single_actor.name: deal_events_single_actor
deal_events_single_actor.value: NOT ("deal_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_events"."actor_partner_id" IS NOT NULL)
